_comment: Six archetypes; for each — 5 named visual variants. Each variant is one distinct individual of that archetype. The generator uses desc for the image prompt and name for the game NPC identity.

IVAN_DURAK.name: Иван Простодушный
IVAN_DURAK.desc: young flaxen-haired peasant lad with smiling face and a slight foolish grin, wearing white linen rubakha embroidered with red cross-stitch, simple kushak belt, bast-shoe lapti

IVAN_DURAK.name: Ванька Горе-Бродяга
IVAN_DURAK.desc: freckled red-haired barefoot wanderer in patched grey kaftan and birch-bark hat, carrying a small wooden staff and a kerchief-bundle on a stick over his shoulder

IVAN_DURAK.name: Иванушка Ленивец
IVAN_DURAK.desc: dreamy chestnut-haired youth lying back on the warm side of a clay stove, in a striped homespun shirt, cheeks pink, blue eyes gazing up at the ceiling, sleepy and untroubled

IVAN_DURAK.name: Иван Серый Волк
IVAN_DURAK.desc: stocky black-bearded young muzhik in a sheepskin tulup and felt valenki, wide guileless face, sitting astride a grey wolf in deep snow

IVAN_DURAK.name: Ванька Перо-Жар
IVAN_DURAK.desc: lanky sandy-haired youth in a crooked papakha and a too-big embroidered coat, balancing a bundle of magic firebird feathers under one arm, expression naively pleased

BABA_YAGA.name: Яга Костяная
BABA_YAGA.desc: ancient hunchbacked crone with a long crooked nose hooking down to her chin, wild grey hair under a faded black headscarf, tattered dark sarafan, holding a bony pestle, eyes glowing pale yellow

BABA_YAGA.name: Ягиня Лесная
BABA_YAGA.desc: skeletal forest witch in a ragged dark green cloak of moss and pine needles, hair like spider-web, a black raven perched on her bony shoulder, knobbed walking stick in her gnarled hand

BABA_YAGA.name: Бабка-Ведьма
BABA_YAGA.desc: stout broad-shouldered hag with iron-grey braids and a single red eye, wearing a crimson and black sarafan stitched with bone beads, stirring a great copper cauldron, mushrooms sprouting from her shawl

BABA_YAGA.name: Яга Куриная Ножка
BABA_YAGA.desc: tall gaunt witch in a black fur-trimmed dushegreya and tall pointed kokoshnik woven from chicken bones, holding a broom of dry birch twigs, fingernails long and yellow

BABA_YAGA.name: Бабушка Нечистая
BABA_YAGA.desc: ancient toothless granny crouched on the stove ledge of her hut on chicken legs, wrapped in many shawls of black and rust-red, clutching a small wooden bowl, single tooth showing

ZOLUSHKA.name: Золушка Пепелышка
ZOLUSHKA.desc: soot-dusted young woman with chestnut hair tied in a simple braid, wearing a patched grey homespun sarafan and a coarse linen apron, kind tired blue eyes, smooth clear face, holding a wooden broom, no scars no wounds

ZOLUSHKA.name: Зорька Стеклянная
ZOLUSHKA.desc: barefoot raven-haired girl in a sky-blue sarafan that is starting to glow at the hem with silver threads, glass slipper just appearing in her hand, twilight light around her, smooth unblemished complexion

ZOLUSHKA.name: Настенька Тихая
ZOLUSHKA.desc: fair-haired stepdaughter in white linen sorochka and dark patched sarafan, hand-feeding doves from a wooden trencher in a frosty courtyard, expression gentle and resolute, smooth clear skin no scars

ZOLUSHKA.name: Дуняша Мышиная
ZOLUSHKA.desc: young woman with golden hair under a simple white kerchief, sitting at a low stool sorting heaps of buckwheat and millet by the firelight, mice gathered to help her, smooth clear complexion no scars

ZOLUSHKA.name: Алёнушка Волшебная
ZOLUSHKA.desc: girl half-transformed: torn working dress on one side, shimmering pearl-embroidered sarafan and silver kokoshnik on the other, fairy-godmother light pouring over her shoulder, smooth clear face no scars

KOSCHEI.name: Кощей Бессмертный
KOSCHEI.desc: tall gaunt sorcerer with skeletal frame, deathly pale skin stretched over high cheekbones, sunken green eyes, long black robe with iron-bone clasps, crowned with a thin twisted iron diadem, fingers tipped with black nails

KOSCHEI.name: Чернокнижник Лютый
KOSCHEI.desc: ancient lich-king seated on a throne of intertwined bones and rusty swords, draped in a moth-eaten purple velvet mantle, holding a small black egg in his clawed hand

KOSCHEI.name: Кощей Воронов
KOSCHEI.desc: shadow-thin warlock in a long fur-trimmed cloak of crow feathers, half-skeletal face partly hidden behind a high collar, riding a gaunt black horse through fog

KOSCHEI.name: Кощей Серебряный
KOSCHEI.desc: decrepit immortal with a wispy grey beard down to his chest, dressed in tarnished silver armour over black chainmail, leaning on a staff topped with a chained skull

KOSCHEI.name: Кощей Тёмный
KOSCHEI.desc: lean noble with bone-white braided hair, in a high-collared black brocade kaftan stitched with silver runes, behind him a chained iron chest in a treasury of skulls

TSAR_GOROKH.name: Царь Горох Великий
TSAR_GOROKH.desc: rotund elderly tsar with a vast white beard cascading over a green and gold brocade kaftan, tall fur-trimmed shapka Monomakha crown studded with rubies, holding a curled sceptre, fond chuckle on his ruddy face

TSAR_GOROKH.name: Царь-Батюшка Гороховый
TSAR_GOROKH.desc: stout old king with thin grey hair and a forked beard, dressed in a heavy crimson and ermine mantle, sitting on a throne shaped like a giant pea pod, plump hands resting on his round belly

TSAR_GOROKH.name: Царь Квасной
TSAR_GOROKH.desc: jolly bald monarch with curly white sideburns, jewel-encrusted golden crown perched askew, wearing a mustard-yellow kaftan embroidered with green peas and pearls, drinking sweet kvass from a horn cup

TSAR_GOROKH.name: Царь Грустный
TSAR_GOROKH.desc: stately silver-bearded tsar with sad benevolent eyes, in a blue and gold robe, holding a tall staff with a globe of carved peas, a flock of carved wooden pigeons at his feet

TSAR_GOROKH.name: Царь-Соня
TSAR_GOROKH.desc: rumpled folk-tale king in slippers and a long nightcap with a tassel, brocade kaftan unbuttoned at the chest, surrounded by piles of scattered gold coins and ledgers

KOLOBOK.name: Колобок Золотой
KOLOBOK.desc: round golden-baked bread roll with a smooth crust, two cheerful black-bead eyes and a wide cracked-crust grin, small flour-dusted limbs, rolling along a forest path, late autumn leaves around

KOLOBOK.name: Колобок Румяный
KOLOBOK.desc: plump dough-roll character with rosy buttery cheeks, an embroidered red sash tied around its middle, tiny stick-thin arms holding a kerchief-bundle, smug expression

KOLOBOK.name: Колобок Горелый
KOLOBOK.desc: weather-worn dark-baked roll with raisin eyes and a slightly burnt crust, sitting on a windowsill of a peasant izba, pretending to look innocent

KOLOBOK.name: Колобочек Нарядный
KOLOBOK.desc: round shiny brioche-like character with a curled crust on top like a topknot, holding a small painted spoon, bouncing along a country lane in front of a forest

KOLOBOK.name: Колобок Ленивый
KOLOBOK.desc: fat sourdough roll with poppy-seed freckles, a wide grin showing crumb-teeth, leaning back lazily on a hay bale in a sunlit field
